text:
If you’re heading out early, bundle up, then enjoy a mostly sunny Thursday that climbs from the 30s into the mid 50s. A north wind will pick up through the day, generally 5 to 14 mph, with some breezier moments, but there’s no rain to plan around. The forecast models split slightly on the high, with one cooler read near 51 and the others near 55, so I’d bet on the middle 50s for Burlington. Skies stay clear tonight, but the temperature drops to around 31, so it’ll feel sharply colder after sunset.

Friday keeps the quiet pattern going, sunny and cooler with a high near 50, plus a north wind around 9 mph. The forecasters’ own discussion is confident about dry, seasonable weather through the weekend and into early next week. Take advantage of the sunshine today, but bring a light jacket for the evening and tomorrow’s walk.
